purpose: Source research and scoped approvals. This file alone does not enable jobs, broaden an adapter, grant media rights or authorize commercial reuse.

sources.name: Давай Сходим · Астана
sources.approvalScope: Reviewed existing noncommercial pilot: one fixed Astana index, robots/terms rechecked each refresh, at most 24 same-origin Event pages and 50 normalized occurrences per shared hourly on-request refresh. No pagination, paid/commercial reuse, photos or private endpoints. This is an application fetch budget, not a publisher-guaranteed quota.
sources.requiredCredit: Давай Сходим + active event source link
sources.accessEvidence: Terms reread 2026-10-20 UTC: noncommercial reuse requires author attribution and links. robots.txt actual HTTP200 at 2026-10-20T18:59:23.066Z: User-agent * with empty Disallow. No expanded live detail crawl performed by the reviewing agent. Prior live run imported 8 occurrences; bundled baseline still 7. Runtime aborts on HTTP403/429 and rechecks policy.
sources.blocker: Publisher does not specify a guaranteed automated-request quota. Stop on denial/policy change; broader pagination/commercial use and individual poster rights need separate permission. Credit must remain visible.

sources.name: Ticketon
sources.accessEvidence: City page fetch failed; direct offer returned 403, official indexed offer readable. No bypass/retry.
sources.blocker: Purchaser agreement is not a data-reuse/API grant. Obtain partner feed with cancellation, field/media/storage/LLM permission. No public API license verified.

sources.name: Kino.kz
sources.accessEvidence: Listing and purchaser agreement readable. Homepage defaulted to Almaty, not Astana; official Become a partner link present.
sources.blocker: No public reusable API/feed license verified. Partner agreement and occurrence-level screenings with audio/subtitle language required. UI locale is not event language; no guessed internal API calls.

sources.name: Visit Astana
sources.accessEvidence: Current page showed empty calendar shell with 2025 selector; historical search-index pages are not current inventory.
sources.blocker: Negotiate structured calendar/export and metadata/media permissions. Date-only ranges do not establish a session time; no stable RSS/ICS/API verified.

sources.name: Astana Opera
sources.accessEvidence: Homepage timeout; direct sample page showed generic support/donation shell while official indexed content had event details. Not reliable live import evidence.
sources.blocker: Request reliable organizer JSON/ICS/CSV export and field/media permission. Search snippets are discovery leads, not confirmed live occurrences.

sources.name: Astana Ballet
sources.accessEvidence: Web reader displayed calendar; one raw HTTP request to same page returned 500. No retry/bypass; adapter not enabled.
sources.blocker: Obtain reliable licensed schedule/feed and explicit year/timezone. Public poster is not a photo grant; repeated performances are separate occurrences.

sources.name: National Museum of Kazakhstan
sources.accessEvidence: Home and exhibition article readable; sample raw HTTP200, no JSON-LD or advertised RSS/ICS observed in that article. Date range 2026-10-13 to 2027-01-13.
sources.blocker: Ongoing automated metadata/media permission required. Exhibition date span intersects opening hours and exception notices; not one continuous 24/7 session, no price/seat guarantee.

sources.name: Meta Threads official API
sources.accessEvidence: Meta docs returned429; not retried. Official Postman overview readable but current keyword-search permission/quota for this app not verified.
sources.blocker: Approved app/scopes/token and policy review required; app ID alone insufficient. Posts are discovery leads, not verified event occurrences; moderator/organizer confirmation before publication, no private account scraping.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap opening_hours
sources.approvalScope: ODbL geographic/tag data with attribution; provider/export policy and collection budget separately required. Does not enable new fetch.
sources.blocker: Need permitted bounded export/provider, proper hours parser, Kazakhstan holidays/exceptions and source-age warnings. Missing hours remain unknown; cafe opening hours do not establish an event/session.

sources.name: Organizer-provided feed
sources.blocker: Best initial live path: explicit owner permission covering fields, photographs, storage, attribution, update interval, cancellation and takedown. Module supports local JSON-LD or approved bounded HTTPS import once permission exists.
